articles.title: 新西兰作家尤金·道尔：全球气候行动中，中国是“房间里成熟的大人”
articles.highlight: 新西兰作家尤金·道尔表示，中国是“房间里成熟的大人”，很多人仍未真正意识到中国对全球能源转型的贡献有多大。
articles.summary: 文章报道《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方大会（COP31）在土耳其安塔利亚举行，并刊发中新网对新西兰作家尤金·道尔的专访。道尔强调中国对全球能源转型的贡献，认为应对气候变化需要行动而非贸易壁垒，地缘政治竞争不应成为气候合作的障碍。该报道有助于了解国际气候讨论中对中国角色的一种公开评价。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发是：在气候合作叙事中，行动与贡献比贸易壁垒和地缘竞争更具说服力；但该报道呈现的是单一受访者观点，阅读时宜结合多方信息判断。

articles.title: Wendell Berry on Where Our Loved Ones Gone Go
articles.highlight: 爱就是与失去签下一份契约；即便如此仍去爱，既是生命的大悲剧，也是大胜利。
articles.summary: 文章借温德尔·贝里的文字讨论爱与失去：爱一个人，就等于与失去签约。两个人相爱后，彼此已嵌入对方生命，即使死亡或幻灭切断联系，这段深刻经历也无法被撤销。它值得读，是因为它把爱的悲剧性与胜利放在同一框架中理解。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：爱无法免于失去，但真正的爱会在彼此生命中留下不可撤销的痕迹，因此失去并不等于爱从未存在。
articles.sourceExcerpt: To love is to sign a contract with loss. To love anyway is both the great tragedy and the great triumph of life. When two people have loved one another, each has become embedded in the marrow of the other’s being and both have had a profound experience that cannot be unhad even when the slender thread of grace between them is severed, by death or disenchantment.

en.highlight: To love is to sign a contract with loss; to love anyway is both the great tragedy and the great triumph of life.
en.summary: Drawing on Wendell Berry, the piece reflects on love and loss: to love someone is to sign a contract with loss. When two people have loved each other, each becomes embedded in the other’s being, and that profound experience cannot be undone even if death or disenchantment severs the thread between them. It is worth reading because it holds love’s tragedy and triumph in the same frame.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: love cannot be protected from loss, but genuine love leaves an irrevocable trace in another person’s life, so loss does not mean love never existed.

articles.sourceExcerpt: An Educated Guess: Deriving Statistically Aligned Gradient Estimates for Zeroth-Order Optimisation Justus Hübotter Serge Thill Marcel van Gerven Nasir Ahmad Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition, and Behaviour Radboud University, Nijmegen, the Netherlands {justus.huebotter, nasir.ahmad}@ru.nl Abstract As novel hardware architectures are explored for the purposes of machine learn- ing, including neuromorphic chips, asynchronous systems, and ASICs, effective learning algorithms are highly desirable. While backpropagation is the standard for differentiation on standard hardware, its requirement for global synchrony and exact differentiability limits the exploration of exotic algorithms on non-traditional substrates and devices. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimisation methods, such as SPSA and weight perturbation, offer a compelling alternative by estimating gradients through inference-only passes; however, these methods have historically suffered due to the ‘curse of dimensionality’, where random perturbations become increasingly misaligned with the true gradient in high-dimensional spaces.
